verdict.rationale: Lium ships an official `lium` CLI. It installs via pip, and the first-party docs and the GitHub repo show agent-friendly commands: `lium up` with `--ttl` auto-removal, `lium exec` returning the remote exit code for scripting, and `lium quote` and `lium spend` for cost visibility. A probe confirms the official CLI is documented at the Datura-ai/lium GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI usage in real agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: pip install lium.io && lium up --gpu H100 --ttl 1h# auto-removes after 1h
lium exec job "nvidia-smi"                              # exits with the remote command's exit code
lium spend                                     # burn per hour, spend per pod, runway
